skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Echo of the Horrorlair
skins.content: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Horrorlair's Enigma' Custom Line/Echo of the Horrorlair. The actor plays the role of the Horrorlair's incarnation, patrolling its corridors and keeping it safe from the patronage of thieves.
skins.quote: Shamare has to give commands to the other actors to protect the treasure of the Horrorlair from pilferage. She may be the only actor here really playing herself.

skins.name: Celestial Crane
skins.content: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Celestial Crane. Outfit made from high-quality Yanese brocade, accompanied with a long ribbon of gauze. At Shamare's request, the remaining fabric was used to make a new look for Morte as well.
skins.quote: Cranes the image of grace, clouds the image of gentleness. Here, a moon embroidered in red shines, a place where quarrels should be left behind.
